yt.title: Argentina was richer than South Korea and Poland in 1990 #Shorts
yt.description:
GDP per person, PPP (IMF WEO Oct 2026): 1990 Argentina $8.3k > Korea $7.7k, Poland $6.7k, Chile $5.9k. 2026: Korea $70k, Poland $60k, Chile $37k, Argentina $33k.

Full video: https://youtu.be/LWCi-qzZxMQ

Sources: IMF World Economic Outlook, October 2026 (PPPPC, NGDPDPC, NGDP_RPCH, PCPIPCH, GGXWDG_NGDP, LUR, LP). "Passed" = GDP per capita in PPP below Argentina's in 2000 and above it every year from the crossing through 2026.
Music by Kevin MacLeod (incompetech.com), CC BY 4.0.
Narration is AI-generated.
